nodes.label: release Specification
nodes.description: Main OpenSpec spec for the release capability (created by archiving build-cooking-hub)

nodes.label: CI workflow (release)
nodes.description: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` SHALL run on pull requests and pushes to `main` with `contents: read` and call `.github/workflows/gate.yml`: on `["self-hosted","homelab-check"]` for pull requests, on `ubuntu-24.04` for pushes to `main`. A newer run for the same pull request SHALL cancel the one still running; push runs SHALL NOT be cancelled. The gate SHALL run `npm ci`, install Playwright Chromium, ru
scenarios: CI is green on the change's PR
Push to main runs on a GitHub-hosted runner
E2E runs against the unpacked tarball

nodes.label: Dependabot (release)
nodes.description: `.github/dependabot.yml` SHALL check `github-actions` and `npm` weekly and ignore semver-major updates of `typescript`.
scenarios: Dependabot config covers actions and npm

nodes.label: Release workflow (release)
nodes.description: `.github/workflows/release.yml` SHALL run on `v*` tags with the jobs `check-tag` (tag equals `v` + `package.json` version, the `ci` push run on the tagged commit succeeded, its artifact has not expired), `publish` (download `release-tarball`, verify the checksum, attest build provenance, `gh release create --generate-notes` with the tarball and `.sha256`, no rebuild) and `bump` (`Rue-Asha/ci/.gith
scenarios: Tag does not match the version
First release bump fails while publish succeeds

nodes.label: Release runbook (release)
nodes.description: `docs/release.md` SHALL describe how a release is cut (bump version, merge, tag `v<version>`, artifact expiry after 90 days) and list every outward step this change needs at Ship and after, each marked ⚠: creating the public repo `Rue-Asha/Rues-Cooking-Hub` with an empty bootstrap commit on `main`, the secrets `HOMELAB_BUMP_APP_ID` / `HOMELAB_BUMP_APP_KEY`, the `main` ruleset in Life-Manager shape

nodes.label: Version 0.1.0 (release)
nodes.description: `package.json` and `package-lock.json` SHALL carry version 0.1.0. After the change is merged, tag `v0.1.0` SHALL be pushed so the release workflow publishes `rues-cooking-hub-0.1.0.tgz` with its sha256.
